questions.stem: How is Data Annotation related to Data Labelling?
options: Data Annotation is a single step within Data Labelling
Data Annotation is the technique of doing Data Labelling
Data Annotation replaces Data Labelling in modern practice
Data Annotation is used for unsupervised learning and Data Labelling for supervised learning
They are unrelated activities performed by different teams
questions.explanation: Data Annotation is the technique of doing Data Labelling; the two work together to prepare datasets for Machine Learning models.

questions.stem: Which of Data Annotation and Data Labelling is the broader activity?
options: Data Labelling, because it contains many annotation steps
Neither; they are identical in scope
Data Labelling, because it is done by humans
Data Annotation, because it is only used for images
Data Annotation, because it is a complete process with many steps, of which Data Labelling is one
questions.explanation: Data Annotation is a complete process with many steps to curate, whereas Data Labelling is one of those steps.

questions.stem: What are Data Labelling tags used for by Machine Learning models?
options: Future pattern recognition
Encrypting the training data
Choosing the database engine
Scheduling batch jobs
Compressing the dataset
questions.explanation: Data Labelling tags are used by ML models for future pattern recognition, while Data Annotation is about recognising the data via a process.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of treating Data Annotation as a process?
options: To increase the number of manual reviewers
To slow down model training for safety
So that Data Labelling can be automated for accuracy, eliminating human intervention
To keep labelled data out of ML models
To convert unstructured data into relational tables
questions.explanation: Data Annotation is about the process so that Data Labelling can be automated for accuracy, eliminating human intervention.

questions.stem: For which kind of Machine Learning does Data Annotation prepare data?
options: Unsupervised learning
Reinforcement learning
Federated learning
Supervised learning
Transfer learning
questions.explanation: Just like Data Labelling, Data Annotation is for supervised machine learning, preparing data as input and storing it for future reference.

questions.stem: Which activity is noted as still being done manually in many organisations?
options: Model deployment
Data backup
Data Labelling
Schema design
Log rotation
questions.explanation: Many organisations are still doing manual Data Labelling, which Data Annotation as a process aims to automate.

questions.stem: What can bad Data Labelling lead to?
options: An adverse impact on the outcome of applications
Faster model training
Reduced storage costs
Automatic correction by the ML model
No effect, since annotation catches every error
questions.explanation: Bad Data Labelling can impact the outcome of applications that rely on the trained models.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements about Data Annotation is NOT correct?
options: It works together with Data Labelling to prepare datasets for ML models
It is the technique for tagging data so ML models can reuse it
It is about recognising data via a process
It stores prepared data for future reference
It is a single step within the larger process of Data Labelling
questions.explanation: It is the other way round: Data Annotation is the complete process and Data Labelling is one of its steps.

questions.stem: What do Data Annotation and Data Labelling together prepare?
options: Network security policies
Financial statements
Backup schedules
Datasets for Machine Learning models in Data Science practice
Database indexes
questions.explanation: Data Annotation and Data Labelling work together to prepare datasets for Machine Learning models in Data Science practice.

questions.stem: Besides preparing data as input for a model, what else does Data Annotation do with the data?
options: Deletes it once the model is trained
Stores it for future reference
Encrypts it with the model's key
Publishes it to external partners
Converts it into a dashboard
questions.explanation: Data Annotation prepares data as input for supervised learning and stores it for future reference.
